description: Figure: ALPP vs ALPG differences by distance to the catalytic core, the Glu429 contact map, and the GO molecular function term sets
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
Dg=pd.read_csv("out/ALPP_vs_ALPG_differences.csv")
M=pd.read_csv("out/mouse_AP_orthology.csv")
alpp=pd.read_csv("out/ALPP_GO_annotations.csv"); alpl=pd.read_csv("out/ALPL_GO_annotations.csv")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.6))
# a) ALPP vs ALPG differences by distance to catalytic core
ax=axes[0]
d=Dg.sort_values("dist_to_catalytic_core_A")
c=["#c0392b" if x<10 else "#9e9e9e" for x in d.dist_to_catalytic_core_A]
ax.barh([f"{a}{p}→{b}" for a,p,b in zip(d.ALPP,d.PLAP_mature,d.ALPG)],d.dist_to_catalytic_core_A,color=c)
ax.axvline(10,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax.text(10.4,0.2,"10 Å shell",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("distance to catalytic core (Å)")
ax.set_title("a  ALPP vs its closest paralog ALPG: 11 differences,\n    only Glu429 and Asn84 near the active site",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)

# b) Glu429 environment
ax=axes[1]
g=pd.read_csv("out/glu429_contacts.csv")
ax.barh(g.contact,g.min_dist_A,color=["#1b6ca8" if v<4 else "#9e9e9e" for v in g.min_dist_A])
for i,v in enumerate(g.min_dist_A): ax.text(v+0.1,i,f"{v:.2f} Å",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,9); ax.set_xlabel("minimum interatomic distance in 1EW2 (Å)")
ax.set_title("b  Glu429 contacts His320, a Zn1 ligand, at 3.40 Å,\n    as predicted from a homology model in 1991 (PMID 1939159)",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)

# c) GO molecular function terms, ALPP vs ALPL
ax=axes[2]; ax.axis("off")
mfP=sorted(set(alpp[alpp.aspect=="molecular_function"].goName))
mfL=sorted(set(alpl[alpl.aspect=="molecular_function"].goName))
lines=["c  Molecular function GO terms (QuickGO, this run)","",
       f"ALPP (P05187), {len(mfP)} terms:"]+["   • "+t for t in mfP]+["",
       f"ALPL (P05186), {len(mfL)} terms:"]+["   • "+t for t in mfL]+["",
       "ALPP has no biological process term; ALPL has 25.",
       "No substrate-restricted MF term exists on ALPP to narrow."]
ax.text(0,1,"\n".join(lines),va="top",fontsize=8.6,linespacing=1.35)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("ALPP MF terms:",mfP)
print("\nSubstrate-specific MF terms on ALPL but absent from ALPP:")
print([t for t in mfL if t not in mfP])
